name: Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon
short_description: A full marathon and multi-distance race held in Tha Bo, Nong Khai, Thailand on May 1, 2027.
ai_summary: The Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon is a full-marathon event scheduled for May 1, 2027, in Tha Bo, Nong Khai, Thailand. Registration for the event is currently open.
